input.rationale: At 2.06 eV illumination, the V-rich corner was tested along with the Fe-rich FeVO4-like region. That corner holds BiVO4-type compositions with Fe added. Index 36 (Bi0.29 Fe0.18 V0.53) gave the highest photocurrent, 7e-8 A. The nearby Bi-richer index 30 gave 6e-8 A. The FeVO4-like index 0 gave only 2e-8 A. The merit budget (3) is spent, so 36 is the best measured composition.

rejected.reason: Fe/V-rich (FeVO4-like) composition measured 2e-8 A, well below the Fe-alloyed BiVO4 region
Bi-richer neighbour of 36 measured 6e-8 A, slightly lower

rejected.hypothesis: Bi-rich and Fe-rich corners (BiFeO3 / Bi-rich oxides)
rejected.reason: Not measured because the budget was small; the only data point on the Fe-rich side (index 0) was poor

content.text:
I submitted **index 36** (Bi 0.29, Fe 0.18, V 0.53). It had the highest photocurrent of the three compositions I measured: 7×10⁻⁸ A.

| Index | Composition (Bi / Fe / V) | Photocurrent |
|---|---|---|
| 36 | 0.29 / 0.18 / 0.53 | 7×10⁻⁸ A |
| 30 | 0.33 / 0.17 / 0.50 | 6×10⁻⁸ A |
| 0 | 0.14 / 0.44 / 0.43 | 2×10⁻⁸ A |

- **Coverage:** with only 3 merit measurements available, I sampled two regions. One was vanadium-rich with a moderate amount of iron (indexes 36 and 30), which scored best. The other was iron- and vanadium-rich with little bismuth (index 0), which scored lowest.
- **Unmeasured regions:** I never measured the bismuth-rich or iron-rich corners. So a better composition elsewhere in the library can't be ruled out.
- **Last pick:** the Gaussian-process model's suggestion wasn't useful with only two data points. I chose index 30 myself, and it came out slightly below index 36.
- **Unused resources:** I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements, so there is no phase identification. The phase list was too large to return, and I didn't read the saved copy.
